verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's own annual-report e-filing documents a registered-agent designation that the entity can change. A registered agent is one of the sanctioned third-party roles the story names. The evidence is a single thin mention: it does not describe what the agent may do for the company, or any authorized-provider or designee program for filing on the company's behalf. Missing for 10: documentation of the registered agent's scope of authority, an authorized-provider or designee filing rail for third parties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Change the registered agent and registered office address.
